name: Spring Boot
summary: A Java framework for building web servers and APIs that run on your own server code.

free_plan_covers.note: Free and open source under the Apache 2.0 license. You pay only for hosting.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The framework itself is free.

portability.note: Packages as a runnable jar or a container image, so it runs on cloud hosts, virtual machines or your own server.

language.note: Written in Java. Kotlin also works.

has_server_code.note: Your controllers run only on the server, so secrets stay private.

uses_react.note: Spring Boot is a server framework. Screens are not written in React unless you add a separate frontend.

setup.step: Create the project at start.spring.io with the Web starter, then push it to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Put settings in application.properties and keep secrets out of it. Spring reads environment variables too, and they override the file.
Environment variable names map to properties by using capitals and underscores: SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL sets spring.datasource.url.
